title: fix: play relative audio paths on Windows
author: Connectslide121

gist.summary: On Windows, `polli gen audio --play` now resolves relative output paths before passing them to `MediaPlayer.Open`; previously, relative URIs failed to load and playback timed out after 10 seconds. macOS and Linux playback are unchanged. The PR lists `@pollinations/cli` version 0.1.34.
